'''FM-6B''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] at the [[Arginall City]] garrison during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This droid injected [[Ketrian Altronel]] with a slow-release poison to prevent her from defecting to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]].<ref name="Firepower" />
